Editing the activities in Meg re-lays the plan

leskraas/trainm8#587 · design run 1 · unattended · one variant · built on ADR 0109 (Proposed)

Chosen: In place run 1 6 decisions two-way doors (the one-way ones were settled in spec) risk: stale refusal off-screen on a phone

In place Chosen: the activities become the editor itself in Meg → Nivå og økter. The start's chips come pre-pressed with the plan's activities; Vis ny uke asks the server and the answer opens under it in the start's own week view (laid by the start's engine for the plan's family), kept sessions marked Din, then Dette endres også and one Bekreft.

Caption: today's read-only list and link to Plan become the chips; the level and preferences form moves under a rule with its own one-line intro, because the page's old intro ("Endrer du her, endres ikke uka som ligger") is no longer true of the activities.

Comparison

In place
Axis positionLayout: editor inline on the page, preview inline under it (not a closed row, not a sheet, not a route)
GainCurrent state is the control: one tap to start, nothing to open; the preview reads exactly as the start's and Bytt treningsform's weeks
CostA long page on a phone: the preview is ~2.5 screens (3+ worst case) and Bekreft sits at its end
Criteria held8 of 12; 3 partly (week total vs "6 timer", stale line off-screen, focus lost after Bekreft); lived weeks are server-only
Worst case1 Broken (stale refusal 656 px above the thumb), 2 Fragile; no overflow at 390, 320 or 200 % text
Build costNot rated (one variant)
StatusChosen · recommended

Decisions

  • Where the editor lives: inline on Nivå og økter, chips pre-pressed, not behind a closed row as Bytt treningsform is (two-way).
  • Choices changed after a preview: the preview goes and one line says to press Vis ny uke again; a Bekreft never stands under a week the chips no longer match (two-way).
  • What the preview says beyond the week: the boundary in words, that the family stays (or which one it takes) and that the round restarts with a building week, then kept sessions (and how many are on a removed sport), Pinned days and cleared weeks, each shown only when there is one (two-way).
  • Where a stale refusal shows: scroll the new preview's top into view and focus its line, so it is read before Bekreft is under the thumb again (two-way; critic).
  • Week total when kept sessions add time: the server's total, split as "6 t fra planen + 1 t 30 min av dine", never a bare total under "6 timer i uka" (two-way; critic).
  • Focus after Bekreft: on the done line, and no rule between the two sections (ui-conventions §1.7) (two-way; critic).
Appendix: method, review, worst-case report, words, rejected directions

Craft: no entrance on the preview and a non-sticky Bekreft are right. Drop the <hr> before the level form (ui-conventions §1.7) and the heading "Nivå og økter du liker", which repeats the page title above the legend "Nivå".

Fit: the start's chips and week view with Bytt treningsform's preview → digest → Bekreft; a step-up check (#639) slots in before Bekreft. If hours or days ever join this editor, move it to its own route.

Designer's pick: In place, the same as the critic's. One difference: the designer keeps a rule so two submits never meet "without a heading between them"; answer: the heading with its intro already does that, and ui-conventions §1.7 puts section separation in the gap alone, so the rule goes.

Method

  • Tool: Emil's prototype (prototype-ui, standalone branch): one self-contained HTML file in the app's tokens (light and dark, Public Sans, the luma radii, pressable, 44 px controls). The picker carries one variant, as an unattended run draws one.
  • Real content: the start's engine (app/utils/first-run/start-draft.ts draftStart) and the real labels module are bundled into the prototype with esbuild, so every week shown is laid by the engine for the chips pressed, and every existing word comes from labels.ts. The plan's own family is chosen from the engine's options (ADR 0109 §1's single-family lay is approximated: the family is laid with the others and picked out).
  • Kept sessions are overlaid in the prototype (on their day, marked Din; a kept lift takes one lifting slot). The real stamp may also move a hard session or lifts (ADR 0109 §5/§6); the server preview decides that.
  • Settled by probe: what the edit's first week looks like for the demo athlete (Mosjonist, 6 t, ma ti to lø sø, Polarisert): ran draftStart under Node for run+bike+2 lifts and run+swim+yoga+2 lifts; it lays 6 t over 5 sessions, 1 hard, lifts Mon/Tue.
  • Settled by probe: does the editor fit 390 × 844 with keyboard reach and 44 px targets: Playwright (repo's @playwright/test, Chromium, isMobile) on every state: 0 px horizontal overflow, no target under 44 px, Tab reaches each chip and Space toggles it, focus ring visible, no console errors.
  • Data: today is Saturday 7 November 2026, so the boundary is Monday 9 November (ISO week 46). Worst case sets today to that Monday with nothing trained (boundary this week).

Engine finding for the critic (not this issue's to fix)

Worst case, real engine: a Nybegynner with 5 days, 3 h, three sports, four Simple Activities and Styrke 3 gets 3 lifts and one 3-hour run on Sunday: lifts count in the cap of 4, so endurance gets 1 session, swim and bike get no day, and every Simple Activity "fikk ikke plass". The preview says all of this in the start's own lines, but a 3-hour single run for a beginner is the start's behaviour and the edit inherits it. Worth a separate issue.

Verdict: Approve. Motion is press feedback only (scale(0.97), 160 ms, ease-out, colours on the same curve, reduced motion drops the scale) and the button spinner (linear, constant). No Block left.

mobile-native checklist

  • Hover gated to (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); tap highlight off; touch-action: manipulation on controls; no text input on this form, so no zoom risk.
  • Long-press: chips and buttons are user-select: none with no callout; body text stays selectable.
  • Bottom tab bar pads the safe area; page bottom padding clears it. Bekreft is not sticky on purpose.
  • Needs a real phone: tap feel of the chip press, scroll-into-view of the preview with the tab bar over the bottom, dark-mode status bar, VoiceOver reading "Din" after a session title.

Rejected directions

  • Closed row, as Bytt treningsform ("Endre aktiviteter" opening a panel): fits an offer in Plan; here the athlete came to change answers, and a closed row hides the current state behind a tap.
  • Bottom sheet for the preview: a week of 7 rows plus three lists is a page, not a sheet; a sheet would scroll inside a scroll.
  • Its own route (/me/aktiviteter): cleaner page, but splits Meg's one "what you answered" page and adds a back step for a two-tap edit.
  • Live week as chips change: rejected by spec decision 2 (cannot see kept sessions).
  • Sticky Bekreft: a confirm that floats over the week invites a press before reading it.

In place Chosen

Working: press chips (Sykling off, Svømming and Yoga on), Vis ny uke, then Bekreft. The harness at the bottom switches data; tick "Uka endres før Bekreft" to see the stale refusal. Press Vis ny uke with nothing changed, or with nothing picked, for the no-op lines.
